bullets.title: Barry Lopez on the Cure for Our Existential Loneliness and the Three Tenets of a Full Life
bullets.note: on _The Marginalian_. Thank you to [Maria Popova](https://tim.blog/2014/10/21/brain-pickings/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertit&utm_campaign=5bf) ([@mariapopova](https://www.instagram.com/mariapopova/?hl=en)) for sending this to me, as she knows I love Barry’s writing. If you’re new to his work and want to sample one of his award-winning books, I suggest starting with [_Of Wolves and Men_](https://www.amazon.com/Wolves-Men-Barry-Holstun-Lopez/dp/0684163225/) or [_Arctic Dreams_](https://www.amazon.com/Arctic-Dreams-Barry-Lopez/dp/0375727485/). They represent nonfiction at its best.

bullets.title: Alone_, Season 7
bullets.note: ([Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Alone-Season-7/dp/B08B1VH3SX), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/show/SCsjo9oAbmSJ-urstiIn24OQ?season=7&sbp=CgE3GhoKGFVDOEJwUmZzbzZPd2JBWXlyWkdPMTlSdw%253D%253D)). In the process of curing your existential loneliness with the first bullet, why not enjoy the lunacy of extended solo survival? I’ve picked up a lot of practical, tactical advice from _Alone_, and it’s an addictive watch. Here is the official description: “In _Alone_, ten people are left in solitude, and separated from each other, in the harsh \[wilderness\]. With no camera crews or producers, they have to survive using only what they can stuff into a backpack. They will hunt, build shelters and fend off predators as they face extreme isolation, psychological distress, and the terrifying plunge into the unknown. Self-documenting their experience, whoever stays the longest wins.” Hat tip to Mr. High Performance himself, [Kelly Starrett](https://thereadystate.com/the-trs-difference/#trsteam), for the recommendation.

bullets.title: The Secret Ingredient That Improves Meat Every Time
bullets.note: ([@kenjilopezalt](https://www.instagram.com/kenjilopezalt/)) for _The New York Times_. Spoiler: “More recently, I’ve been testing the limits of cooking with mayonnaise and discovering it may just be the most magical marinade ingredient I’ve ever encountered. I mean it.” Once you have watched a few episodes of _Alone_ and seen people starving, mayo will seem like the decadence that it is. Read this article before you judge.
